description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmailManViewList' which extends 'ViewList' to manage the list view for email management in the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for pre-display setup, module title customization, view preparation, and processing, including rendering an HTML form for sending queued emails.

classes.name: EmailManViewList
classes.description: A class extending ViewList to handle the email management list view, including pre-display user permissions check, module title setup, and rendering a form for email delivery actions.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Performs user permission checks and initializes the list view object for display.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including a link to the administration module and a localized title.

methods.name: listViewPrepare
methods.description: Prepares the list view display settings and outputs the module title.

methods.name: listViewProcess
methods.description: Processes and renders the HTML form with a button for sending queued emails.
